'''Yumiko Sudou''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|須|す}}{{ruby|藤|どう}}ゆみこ}}''') is the creator of several [[Pokémon manga]] born on May 19 in the {{wp|Tochigi Prefecture}}. Her manga, usually aimed at children, have been published by [[Shogakukan]].

Before the January issue of ''[[CoroCoro|Bessatsu CoroCoro Comics]]'', she would prefer a pen-name, such as "Yumi". She is also associated with ''Televi-kun'', a {{wp|Shogakukan}} monthly manga magazine aimed at boys. Her other Nintendo manga series have included ''{{smw|Donkey Kong (series)|Donkey Kong}}'' and ''{{lsw|The Legendary Starfy (series)|The Legendary Starfy}}''.
